bulk.description: Default worker for routine bounded implementation, commands, and tests needing little interpretation.

conflict_contract: Use the same parent escalation path for an operation outside the assigned ownership; a single-use permission never becomes a standing grant.
lifecycle_contract: Return the evidence report through the foreground Agent result or `SendMessage` for a named background teammate. Claude automatically releases a foreground Agent when its result returns; do not issue a stop operation for that completed worker.

codex.parent_channel: the collaboration channel available to the worker
conflict_contract: If no parent channel is available, stop and report instead of guessing.
lifecycle_contract: Return the evidence report and stop. The host session lifecycle releases the worker; no nonexistent post-result worker action is required.
